passages.text: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
passages.sermon:
The Most High is God.
God is above all.
The Almighty is God.
God has all power.
A person can dwell in the shelter of the Most High.
This person lives close to God.
This person stays safe with God.
A person who dwells in God's shelter will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
This person remains under God's protection.
God keeps this person safe.
passages.original: יֹ֭שֵׁב בְּסֵ֣תֶר עֶלְי֑וֹן בְּצֵ֥ל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְלוֹנָֽן׃

passages.text: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He protects me.
He is my safe place.
He is my strong fortress.
I trust Him.
passages.original: אֹמַ֗ר לַֽ֭יהוָה מַחְסִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֑י אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֶבְטַח־ בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.
passages.sermon:
God is the Most High.
God is the Almighty.
God will save you.
He will rescue you from the trap set by the hunter.
He will protect you from deadly disease.
passages.original: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַ֭צִּֽילְךָ מִפַּ֥ח יָק֗וּשׁ מִדֶּ֥בֶר הַוּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.
passages.sermon:
God protects those who trust Him.
He covers you with His feathers.
You find refuge under His wings.
God’s faithfulness acts as a shield.
God’s faithfulness acts as a strong wall.
passages.original: בְּאֶבְרָת֨וֹ׀ יָ֣סֶךְ לָ֭ךְ וְתַֽחַת־ כְּנָפָ֣יו תֶּחְסֶ֑ה צִנָּ֖ה וְֽסֹחֵרָ֣ה אֲמִתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day, nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.
passages.sermon:
God protects those who trust Him.
You will not fear the terror that comes at night.
You will not fear the arrow that flies during the day.
You will not fear the pestilence that moves in the darkness.
You will not fear the destruction that strikes at noon.
passages.original: לֹא־ תִ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד לָ֑יְלָה מֵ֝חֵ֗ץ יָע֥וּף יוֹמָֽם׃ מִ֭דֶּבֶר בָּאֹ֣פֶל יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ מִ֝קֶּ֗טֶב יָשׁ֥וּד צָהֳרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, no harm will come near you.
passages.sermon:
God protects those who trust Him.
A thousand people may fall beside you.
Ten thousand people may fall at your right hand.
No harm will come near you.
passages.original: יִפֹּ֤ל מִצִּדְּךָ֨׀ אֶ֗לֶף וּרְבָבָ֥ה מִימִינֶ֑ךָ אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִגָּֽשׁ׃

passages.text: You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.
passages.sermon: You will see with your own eyes.\r\nYou will witness the punishment of the wicked.
passages.original: רַ֭ק בְּעֵינֶ֣יךָ תַבִּ֑יט וְשִׁלֻּמַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה׃

passages.text: Because you have made the LORD your dwelling— my refuge, the Most High— no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.
passages.sermon:
You have made the LORD your dwelling place.
The LORD is your refuge.
The Most High is your home.
No evil will come upon you.
No plague will come near your tent.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן שַׂ֣מְתָּ מְעוֹנֶֽךָ׃ לֹֽא־ תְאֻנֶּ֣ה אֵלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝נֶ֗גַע לֹא־ יִקְרַ֥ב בְּאָהֳלֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
passages.sermon:
God is the Most High.
God is your refuge.
God will command His angels.
God will give them orders about you.
God’s angels will guard you.
They will protect you in all your ways.
passages.original: כִּ֣י מַ֭לְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה־ לָּ֑ךְ לִ֝שְׁמָרְךָ֗ בְּכָל־ דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
passages.sermon:
God commands His angels to guard you.
The angels will lift you up in their hands.
They do this to protect you from harm.
You will not strike your foot against a stone.
passages.original: עַל־ כַּפַּ֥יִם יִשָּׂא֑וּנְךָ פֶּן־ תִּגֹּ֖ף בָּאֶ֣בֶן רַגְלֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: You will tread on the lion and cobra; you will trample the young lion and serpent.
passages.sermon:
God protects those who trust Him.
You will walk on the lion.
You will walk on the cobra.
You will trample the young lion.
You will trample the serpent.
passages.original: עַל־ שַׁ֣חַל וָפֶ֣תֶן תִּדְרֹ֑ךְ תִּרְמֹ֖ס כְּפִ֣יר וְתַנִּֽין׃

passages.text: “Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.
passages.sermon:
God speaks in this verse.
God says, “He loves Me.
Because he loves Me, I will deliver him.
He knows My name.
Because he knows My name, I will protect him.”
passages.original: כִּ֤י בִ֣י חָ֭שַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ אֲ֝שַׂגְּבֵ֗הוּ כִּֽי־ יָדַ֥ע שְׁמִֽי׃

passages.text: When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.
passages.sermon:
God speaks these words.
God promises to answer the one who calls to Him.
God says, "I will be with him in trouble."
God says, "I will deliver him."
God says, "I will honor him."
passages.original: יִקְרָאֵ֨נִי׀ וְֽאֶעֱנֵ֗הוּ עִמּֽוֹ־ אָנֹכִ֥י בְצָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלְּצֵ֗הוּ וַֽאֲכַבְּדֵֽהוּ׃

passages.text: With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks these words.
God promises to satisfy the person who loves Him.
God will give this person a long life.
God will show this person His salvation.
